__doc: Floors per model for the share of replies handled right on cases.json (run.js --gate), as ratios.
floor = observed - 2 binomial SE over the 70 conversations, rounded down, like evals/kody-rules/kody-targets.json.
deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks (the nightly model): calibrated 2026-10-15 from 4 runs of the same classifier: 3 local
(68, 68, 68 of 70; the same two missed, rhetorical-comment and pr-template-text, both expected respond) and the
first CI run of the shared nightly job (66 of 70, run 38658146036). Mean 96.4%. No reply meant for someone else
was answered in the local runs. One CI run already moved 2 cases, so the margin is the binomial SE, not zero.

2026-10-16, cloud route: the model now comes from the org's cloud route (evals/shared/model-route.js) instead of the self-hosted env route (applyModelEnv); on deepseek the request bodies are identical but for reasoning_effort, which the env route sent as high and the managed route leaves unset. Two runs on it: 69 and 68 of 70 (pr-template-text missed in both, rhetorical-comment in one), mean 97.9%. floor = 0.979 - 2 x 0.017 (binomial SE over 70) = 0.944, rounded down to 0.94.
gpt-6-sol: calibrated 2026-10-17 from 2 local runs on a725253d6: 68/70 and 70/70, mean 0.986. floor = min(mean - 2 binomial SE, (n - 2) / n) over n = 70, rounded down: 0.95.
claude-sonnet-5-5: calibrated 2026-10-17 from 2 local runs on a725253d6: 69/70 and 69/70, mean 0.986. floor = min(mean - 2 binomial SE, (n - 2) / n) over n = 70, rounded down: 0.95.

kimi-k2.7-code@openrouter: calibrated 2026-10-17 from 2 local runs on a725253d6 and 8971e8fb3: 68/70 and 69/70, mean 0.979. floor = min(mean - 2 binomial SE, (n - 2) / n) over n = 70, rounded down: 0.94.

deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks: calibrated 2026-10-17 from 2 local runs on 641fb1999 (BYOK route): 69/70 and 69/70, mean 0.986. floor = min(mean - 2 binomial SE, (n - 2) / n) over n = 70, rounded down: 0.95.
RATCHET: when a PR moves this on purpose, recalibrate here with two runs as evidence.

2026-10-16: the eval now runs the use case's own path (reply-thread.ts: the thread rebuilt from GitHub-shaped comments, the gate, the conversation route through PermissionValidationService). The prompt is identical on 441 of the 443 cases of both datasets; the two that differ are bot replies, now named by their GitHub login. deepseek on it: 67 and 68 of 70 (rhetorical-comment and pr-template-text missed in both, push-notification once), inside the runs above; the floor stays.
